about: Tiny 4-question dataset for the CI harness smoke test. It is NOT grounded in the real corpus — it is paired with a deterministic in-process mock Atlas (atlas_evals.testing) so the whole pipeline (run -> results schema -> report -> compare) can be exercised on every PR without an OpenAI key, a running stack, or Docker. One keyword (hits), one semantic (keyword engine misses), one unanswerable (abstains), one designed to miss (retrieval + citation both wrong).

questions.question: What are the tasks of the data protection officer?
questions.notes: Mock returns the expected chunk on all engines -> document + page hit everywhere.

questions.question: Can I get a copy of my data in a reusable format and move it to another provider?
questions.notes: Mock returns the expected chunk on vector/hybrid but NOTHING on keyword -> keyword miss (mirrors the real keyword-collapse-on-semantic finding).

questions.question: What is the recommended daily amount of water an adult should drink?
questions.notes: Out of the mock world; retrieval is skipped and chat returns no citations -> correct abstention.

questions.question: What must a crypto-asset white paper for an asset-referenced token contain?
questions.notes: Designed to miss: the mock returns a wrong document for retrieval and cites a wrong document in chat -> document/page miss and a citation-document failure (exercises the failure-evidence path).
